prompt: A logo has quadrilateral $WXYZ$ with all four vertices on a circle. If $\angle W = 95^\circ$, what is the measure of the opposite angle $\angle Y$, in degrees?
hint: When all four vertices lie on a circle, opposite angles are supplementary.

hints.text: When all four vertices lie on a circle, opposite angles are supplementary.

explanation: In a quadrilateral inscribed in a circle, each pair of opposite angles adds to $180^\circ$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Why the rule works
steps: $\angle W$ and $\angle Y$ are inscribed angles intercepting the two arcs that together make the whole circle, $360^\circ$.
Each angle is half its arc, so together they are half of $360^\circ$, which is $180^\circ$.
